CustomField.description: Set TRUE by F-14-After when any Quote Line has a discount exceeding the Sales Rep threshold from Discount_Threshold__mdt. Triggers Sales Manager approval routing in the Quote approval chain.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked automatically when a quote line discount exceeds the sales rep's authorised threshold. Routes the quote through Sales Manager approval before it can be submitted to the customer.
CustomField.label: Discount Approval Required
